man-3x02: Din Djarin reaches Mandalore's ruins, where Bo-Katan frees him from a cyborg captor. He sinks into the Living Waters, and diving to save him, she glimpses a mythosaur.
man-3x03: After Imperial bombers level Bo-Katan's castle, Din rejoins his tribe as redeemed; on Coruscant, Elia Kane lures amnestied Dr. Pershing back to cloning, then betrays him.
man-3x04: When a raptor carries off Paz Vizsla's son, Bo-Katan leads the rescue party that saves him, while Grogu recalls Kelleran Beq spiriting him out of the Jedi Temple.
man-3x05: Pirates besiege Nevarro and the New Republic won't help, so Teva turns to Din; the united Mandalorians rout Shard, and Teva finds Gideon's prison shuttle wrecked and empty.
man-3x06: Seeking her old crew on Plazir-15, Bo-Katan and Din unmask a droid-sabotage plot for its Duchess; after she bests Axe Woves, Din hands her the Darksaber.
man-3x07: Bo-Katan unites the Mandalorian factions to reclaim their homeworld, but beneath Sundari they walk into Moff Gideon's trap: Paz Vizsla falls to Praetorian Guards and Din is captured.
man-3x08: Reunited with Grogu, Din joins Bo-Katan to destroy Moff Gideon and his base, the Great Forge is relit, and Din adopts Grogu before they settle on Nevarro.
ahs-1x01: Baylan Skoll frees Morgan Elsbeth as Ahsoka finds a map to Thrawn; her estranged apprentice Sabine unlocks it, but Shin Hati wounds Sabine and takes the map.
ahs-1x02: Tracing the droid to Corellia's shipyards, Ahsoka and Hera expose Imperial loyalists building a hyperdrive for Elsbeth; Ahsoka duels Marrok, and a tracked transport flees toward Seatos.
ahs-1x03: Senators rebuff Hera's plea for reinforcements, while Ahsoka trains Sabine en route to Seatos, where Shin Hati's fighters force them down near an enemy base.
ahs-1x04: Ahsoka cuts down Marrok, but Baylan drives her off a cliff; promised a reunion with Ezra, Sabine hands him the map and leaves with the enemy.
ahs-1x05: Anakin's spirit makes Ahsoka relive her wartime past and choose to live; pulled from the sea by Hera's search, she and Huyang hitch a ride with the purrgil.
ahs-1x06: On Peridea, Sabine meets Thrawn and is released to seek Ezra; she survives bandits, follows the Noti, and finds him, as the Great Mothers sense a Jedi coming.
ahs-1x07: C-3PO saves Hera from court-martial with Leia's after-the-fact blessing; on Peridea, Ahsoka survives Baylan and reunites with Ezra and Sabine amid a clash with Thrawn's troopers.
ahs-1x08: Ahsoka slays Morgan Elsbeth, but Thrawn's Chimaera escapes home; Sabine Force-pushes Ezra aboard in time, leaving herself and Ahsoka stranded on Peridea.
skc-01: Daydreaming Wim and three At Attin schoolmates follow a hidden hatch to a starship buried in the woods, then accidentally wake it and blast off into space.
skc-02: Guided by the cranky droid SM-33, the kids reach pirate haven Borgo Prime, where Wim's antique coin stirs trouble and pirates jail them beside a hooded stranger.
skc-03: Jod springs the kids from Borgo Prime and takes them to astronomer Kh'ymm for At Attin's location, but her quiet alert brings New Republic X-wings after them.
skc-04: On war-torn At Achrann, a lost world like their own, the kids get conscripted until Jod ransoms them, then unlocking SM-33's memory of At Attin turns him murderous.
skc-05: On resort world Lanupa, SM-33 guides the crew through Captain Rennod's booby-trapped lair to At Attin's coordinates, and Jod turns on the kids to seize the ship.
skc-06: As Jod buys his life by promising the pirates At Attin's treasure, the quarreling kids repair KB's failing implants and rescue the Onyx Cinder from a scrapper's claws.
skc-07: As parents smuggle a message past the Barrier, pirates snare the homebound kids; Jod ousts Brutus and flies their ship down to At Attin, hailed as an emissary.
skc-08: Jod opens At Attin to his pirates, but the kids and their parents fight back; KB's call brings the New Republic, the Barrier falls, and Jod is beaten.
res-1x01: Poe plants pilot Kaz Xiono undercover on the Colossus fuel platform, where his bragging leads to a race against Torra Doza and a crash into the sea.
res-1x03: Kaz overhears a shifty client plotting a pirate raid under cover of a storm, then eavesdrops on the raiders' comms to help the Aces drive Kragan Gorr off.
res-1x04: Eager for friends, Kaz lets smooth-talking racer Jace Rucklin use him to steal Yeager's volatile hyperfuel, then has to rescue Rucklin when his overfueled racer blows.
res-1x05: As blackouts hit the Colossus, Kaz uses Hype Fazon's invitation to enter Doza Tower and overhears Major Vonreg pressing Captain Doza to accept First Order protection.
res-1x06: Needing credits for a repair, Kaz chases a bounty on two runaway kids, then learns Kel and Eila escaped the First Order's conquest of Tehar and shields them.
res-1x07: With Poe, Kaz answers a distress call to a raided freighter whose escaped beasts are eating pirates, and rescues Synara San, never guessing she's a pirate herself.
res-s01: Sent by Yeager to fetch Kaz, BB-8 roams the Colossus market and Aunt Z's tavern, only to come home and find Kaz there, now hunting for Yeager.
res-1x08: As Team Fireball rushes to arm the Colossus's cannons, Synara befriends Tam and tips off Kragan's raiders; the raid is repelled, but Doza calls in the First Order.
res-1x09: Yeager's estranged brother, star racer Marcus Speedstar, must win the Platform Classic to ransom his mechanic from the Guavians; racing beside him, Yeager starts to forgive.
res-1x10: With Torra's unwitting help, Kaz sneaks into Doza Tower during Commander Pyre's visit, copies Doza's pending deal with the First Order, and finds the captain's old Imperial uniform.
res-1x11: After handing Leia the Doza proposal, Kaz scouts Station Theta Black with Poe, finding a dedlanite mine for blasters just as Phasma arrives to destroy it.
res-1x12: Neeku takes in a tiny sea creature he names Bibo, until its colossal mother besieges the station and he must tearfully return his new pet.
res-1x13: Minding Flix and Orka's shop, Kaz is hauled aboard a First Order transport with a stolen part and, helped by a biting gorg, crashes it into the sea.
res-s02: Kaz brags his way through a holo-darts showing at Aunt Z's, then Bucket steps up, nails two bull's-eyes, and bounces a wild third throw into Kaz's backside.
res-s03: Treated to lunch by Yeager, Neeku picks a live gorg that keeps escaping across the Colossus market, until he settles for bantha milk instead.
res-s07: Missing his helmet, a panicked Bucket retraces his steps across the Colossus and gets saddled with a propeller hat, then finds BB-8 wearing the original.
res-s04: Narb robs Flix and Orka at gunpoint; they let him load up before a hidden trapdoor swallows him, and his brother Nod soon meets the same fate.
res-s05: Flix and Orka shoot open a salvaged chest from Synara, accidentally arm the thermal detonators inside, ditch them in the sea, and promptly buy another mystery chest.
res-s06: Orka lets pit droid G-LN finish his blurrgfire, and the tipsy droid tears through Aunt Z's tavern picking fights until the locals knock him flat.
res-s08: Hype Fazon brings his balky astromech R4-G77 to Flix and Orka, and the droid fights off their repairs with a spark projector until Orka pins it.
res-s09: Torra races Hype Fazon for the top Ace ranking and leads most of the way, but she burns her boosters too soon and Hype snatches the win.
res-s12: Testing the Fireball's engines alongside Torra, Kaz snaps the throttle off mid-flight and skids into the hangar, only for the landing gear to give way.
res-s11: Escorting a fuel freighter crippled by pirates, the five Aces latch onto it and drag it to a stop just short of smashing into the Colossus.
res-s10: Pet-sitting Torra's Voorpak Buggles, Kaz chases him around the repair shop and along the Colossus's dangerous ledges, until Buggles fires up the Fireball and takes off.
res-1x14: At Pyre's bidding, Kragan's pirates kidnap Torra Doza; a conflicted Synara warns Kaz, and the First Order stages a rescue that plants troops on the Colossus.
res-1x15: As First Order troops occupy the Colossus, stormtroopers hunt a pirate spy, and Kaz, knowing Synara's secret, slips her off the station in an escape pod.
res-1x16: After a stormtrooper corners Kel and Eila, Kaz borrows the downed trooper's armor, slips into the First Order garrison, and steals a data rod revealing its massing fleets.
fod-1x15: With her speeder staked on a salvage job for Unkar Plutt, Rey finds a wheezing happabore in the way, clears its nose, and gains a hauling partner.
fod-2x05: Robbed at gunpoint by Teedo inside a crumbling Star Destroyer, Rey watches him yank a load-bearing part she'd left alone, then carries him out as the wreck collapses.
res-1x17: Poe and Kaz probe a dead system whose sun has vanished and whose worlds are hollowed out, then Poe takes BB-8 off to Jakku, leaving CB-23 with Kaz.
res-1x18: As the First Order grounds racers and makes dissenters vanish, Kaz and Torra free the captives to flee with Aunt Z, but Pyre's troops descend on Kaz's crew.
res-1x19: Hunted by Pyre, Kaz and Yeager partly sink the Colossus to knock out its comm jammer; Yeager is captured, but Kaz reaches Leia and rallies a local resistance.
fod-1x01: Heading home with BB-8, Rey battles a burrowing nightwatcher worm that snatches the droid, wrests him free, and buys peace by feeding it scrap.
fod-1x02: Speeding across Jakku with BB-8, Rey tricks two thugs into colliding, then lures Teedo into a wrecked Star Destroyer where a nightwatcher worm devours his speeder.
fod-1x10: When the Falcon lurches out of hyperspace, Rey and Chewie hunt down a tracking bomb likely planted by Unkar Plutt, and Chewie hurls it out an airlock.
res-1x20: Kaz leads the Colossus underground on a mission to free their captured friends, but mid-rescue he watches Starkiller Base annihilate the Hosnian system, and with it his family.
res-1x21: Kaz frees Yeager and Doza, Tam leaves with the First Order, and the Colossus, revealed as a starship, rises from the sea and jumps away under Ace cover.
res-2x01: Lost after a blind jump, the Colossus crew battle failing gravity and a stowaway First Order droid leaking their position, while Tam becomes a First Order cadet pilot.
fod-2x13: Fleeing across Starkiller Base in a stolen snowspeeder, Rey and Finn shake off snowtrooper pursuers through forest and trench, then jump a gorge and settle who flies.
fod-2x08: While Rey struggles to lift stones on Ahch-To, a porg steals her lightsaber; chasing it to a cliff, she stops the thief midair with the Force.
fod-2x12: Porgs raid the Falcon for blue wiring; Chewie and R2-D2 track them to a nest of chicks, and Chewie braves fierce winds to fetch blue moss instead.
fod-2x03: Bound for Canto Bight, Finn and Rose's pod is snagged by a huge airborne jellyfish that fries BB-8; Finn takes the controls while Rose revives the droid.
res-2x02: Learning his father survived, Kaz finds D'Qar's base destroyed and talks Kragan's pirates into salvaging coaxium from a wrecked First Order dreadnought to refuel the Colossus.
res-2x03: Yeager whips the showboating Aces into a combat squad, with Kaz finally earning Hype's respect as a wingmate, while Tam trains as a First Order pilot.
res-2x04: With food gone and Aunt Z set to leave, Kaz and Torra return to icy Celsor 3 and use Tam's unfinished cannon to bring down a giant jakoosk.
res-2x05: Kaz and Synara rescue Nena, a stranded engineer who helps repair the Colossus and wins Neeku's trust, until she is exposed as Agent Tierny's saboteur.
res-2x06: Seeking fuel on Flix's stormy homeworld of Drahgor III, Kaz and friends help his Gozzo cousins escape the ancient dragons their deep drilling stirred, earning the fuel.
res-2x07: Shopping on Ashas Ree, Kaz trails stowaways Kel and Eila into a Sith temple, where the enigmatic Mika Grey turns a Sith relic on First Order raiders.
res-2x08: Resistance pilot Venisa Doza, Torra's mother, is captured before a secret family rendezvous; aboard the Thunderer she tries to reach cadet Tam, then blasts her way free.
res-2x09: Hype talks Doza into racing at gambler Vranki's casino for a payday, but Vranki traps the Colossus and rigs the race, and the Aces must win their freedom.
res-2x10: Hexed by a sore-losing pirate, Kaz blames every mishap on the curse, until, without even Mika Grey's lucky charm, he masters his fear and downs Guavian fighters.
res-2x11: At a First Order fuel station during Hux's visit, Tam spots Kaz and Neeku stealing a vital deflector and, after Rucklin traps them, secretly opens their way out.
res-2x12: Tracing a Resistance spy's distress call, Kaz, Yeager, and Synara find Norath Kev captive aboard bounty hunter Ax's ship and bring it down as the First Order arrives.
res-2x13: When Ax Tagrin hands CB-23, Yeager, and Synara to the First Order, Kaz and Norath Kev don trooper armor to free them, and the Aces cover their escape.
res-2x14: Kragan arms his pirates with old super battle droids to seize the Colossus, but Neeku, secretly spying for Yeager, helps crush the mutiny, and Synara turns on Kragan.
res-2x15: Hoping to settle on Aeos Prime, the Colossus meets hostile Aeosians scarred by a First Order strike; captured, Kaz wins over their Queen by tending their wounded.
res-2x16: Kaz resolves to join the Resistance, but the First Order finds the Colossus at Aeos Prime; he strikes the Thunderer's bridge, clashing with Tam, as the ship escapes.
res-2x17: The Aces join Venisa's battered squadron to shepherd Resistance recruits off occupied Dantooine; a shuttle is lost, but Doza, done running, pledges the Colossus to the Resistance.
res-2x18: Sickened by the First Order's massacre on Aeos Prime, Tam defects with Kaz and Yeager's help, and the Colossus rises to destroy the Thunderer and bring her home.
fod-star-wars-forces-of-destiny-volume-1: Maz Kanata introduces eight shorts spanning the eras: Rey saves BB-8 from a Jakku worm, Jyn shields a girl's tooka, Leia helps Wicket, and Ahsoka trains with Anakin.
fod-star-wars-forces-of-destiny-volume-2: Maz Kanata presents eight more shorts: Ahsoka and Padmé unmask an impostor, Leia searches Echo Base for Chewie, Sabine and Jyn cross paths, and Rey outwits Unkar Plutt.
fod-star-wars-forces-of-destiny-volume-3: Maz Kanata hosts eight shorts, from Hera and Sabine's medkit heist and Luke's training on Dagobah to Rey hauling Teedo from a collapsing Star Destroyer.
fod-star-wars-forces-of-destiny-volume-4: Locked in her own brig after Hondo Ohnaka double-crosses her, Maz Kanata introduces eight shorts while plotting her escape, then turns the tables and traps Hondo instead.
cw03-1x01: As war engulfs the galaxy, Kenobi is sent to smash the Banking Clan's droid factories on Muunilinst, and Palpatine overrules the Jedi to give Anakin command in space.
cw03-1x02: Anakin bristles at Obi-Wan's lecture on obedience, then leads the starfighters as the Muunilinst assault begins, while the ARC troopers' gunship is shot down deep in the city.
cw03-1x03: Stranded in Harnaidan, the ARC troopers fight through droid snipers and a tank, then scale the Banking Clan's giant artillery cannon and rig it to blow.
cw03-1x04: As panic grips the Banking Clan's headquarters, Durge throttles a carping San Hill, then leads his IG lancer droids to rout the clones outside Harnaidan.
cw03-1x05: Kit Fisto leads scuba troopers and Mon Calamari Knights to retake Mon Calamari from the Quarren separatists, shoving their crab cannon off an undersea cliff.
cw03-1x06: Seeking Jango Fett's successor in Rattatak's gladiator pits, Dooku watches a cloaked warrior, Asajj Ventress, defeat every fighter in the arena and claim to be Sith.
cw03-1x07: Dooku scorns Ventress's Sith claim and beats her in a brutal duel, then Sidious sends her, newly armed, to kill Anakin, caring only that she test him.
cw03-1x08: Kenobi leads clone swoop riders against Durge's lancer droids in a massive joust, then fights Durge himself, cutting the bounty hunter apart, unaware the Gen'Dai is already regenerating.
cw03-1x09: Kenobi's ARC troopers storm the Banking Clan's command tower, but a regenerated Durge engulfs Obi-Wan, who bursts him from within with the Force, and San Hill surrenders.
cw03-1x10: Above Muunilinst, Anakin steers Geonosian fighters into clone missiles and wrecks a gun platform, then vows to take on a lethal new starfighter, unaware Ventress is its pilot.
cw03-1x11: Anakin chases the mystery fighter through Harnaidan's streets, then defies Obi-Wan's orders and follows it into hyperspace, sensing its pilot is strong in the Force.
cw03-1x12: On Dantooine, Mace Windu's advance against the droid army is shattered by a Separatist seismic tank, leaving him cut off among super battle droids without his lightsaber.
cw03-1x13: Stripped of his lightsaber, Mace Windu smashes super battle droids with Force-driven fists, recovers his blade to finish the seismic tank, and accepts water from young Paxi Sylo.
cw03-1x14: On Ilum, Barriss Offee completes her lightsaber under Luminara Unduli's guidance, but Separatist chameleon droids strike the crystal cave, and a cave-in traps both Jedi.
cw03-1x15: Yoda mind-tricks Captain Typho into diverting Padmé's yacht to Ilum, a ruse only she notices, then fights through chameleon droids to reach the trapped Jedi.
cw03-1x16: Heading after Yoda with R2-D2 and C-3PO, Padmé destroys the chameleon droids that ambush her; Yoda returns with the rescued Jedi, and R2 traces the attack to Dooku.
cw03-1x17: On Yavin 4, a hidden Force user picks off the clones sent after Anakin and blows up his starfighter, then Ventress strides from the flames to face him.
cw03-1x18: Anakin and Ventress duel through Yavin 4's jungle, hurling trees with the Force and battling up to a Massassi temple roof, where they square off in the rain.
cw03-1x19: Atop a rain-lashed Massassi temple, Anakin wrests away one of Ventress's lightsabers and, in a fury haunted by visions of his mentors, drives her into a chasm.
cw03-1x20: As Muunilinst falls and a contrite Anakin returns, a distress call from Hypori heralds General Grievous, who tears through a band of cornered Jedi.
cw03-2x21: Captain Fordo's ARC troopers snatch Ki-Adi-Mundi and the surviving Jedi from Grievous on Hypori; with the Order stretched thin, the Council knights Anakin, and Padmé gives him R2-D2.
cw03-2x22: After a run of victories, Obi-Wan and Anakin follow a report of Grievous to icebound Nelvaan, where Anakin kills a horax and enrages the natives.
cw03-2x23: A Separatist armada storms Coruscant and Grievous bursts in on Palpatine, while on Nelvaan a shaman hails Anakin as a prophesied savior and sends him on a trial.
cw03-2x24: Shaak Ti's Jedi rush Palpatine across Coruscant with Grievous in pursuit; on Nelvaan, Anakin glimpses his dark future in cave pictograms and finds captive warriors being mutated.
cw03-2x25: Anakin frees Nelvaan's mutated warriors and destroys the machine freezing their world, while Grievous cuts down Palpatine's guards, seizes the Chancellor, and flees, his chest crushed by Windu.
drd-1x01: Dumped on Ingo, R2-D2 and C-3PO join racers Thall Joben and Jord Dusat, then help snatch Jord from gangster Tig Fromm's base aboard the speeder White Witch.
drd-1x02: Sheltering with Rebel Kea Moll on Annoo, Thall, Jord, and the droids dodge a Fromm assassin droid, then steal the gang's weapons satellite, the Trigon One.
drd-1x03: The Fromms seize Kea's mother and reclaim the Trigon One, but Thall, Kea, and the droids escape Sise Fromm's fortress as the satellite plunges into it.
drd-1x04: Hunted by Boba Fett for the vengeful Fromms, Thall's team wins the Boonta Speeder Race and a job offer, but the droids leave so their friends can accept.
drd-1x05: Miner Jann Tosh takes in the droids and a supposed android he names Kez-Iban, really the lost Prince Mon Julpa, and they escape crime lord Kleb Zellock's mines.
drd-1x06: Jann, the droids, and pilot Jessica Meade escort Mon Julpa home to Tammuz-an, where they foil the scheming Vizier Zatec-Cha and see the prince crowned king.
drd-1x07: Pirate Kybo Ren captures Jann, Jessica, and the droids on a fuel run; they escape his Tarnoonga lair and help Mon Julpa's navy beat his stolen Star Destroyer.
drd-1x08: Kybo Ren escapes and kidnaps Lord Toda's daughter Gerin; Jann and the droids stall the pirates while Toda's hidden warriors spring a trap, sealing peace with Mon Julpa.
drd-1x09: Escorting Prince Coby to the Imperial Academy, the droids help him chase poachers who stole his pet Ingey, and with the Fuzzums they free a captive menagerie.
lf-great-heep: On Biitu, Artoo and Threepio join their new master Mungo Baobab against the Great Heep, a colossal droid sucking the planet dry, and destroy its moisture eater.
drd-1x10: Chasing a map to the fabled Roon system, Mungo and the droids are captured at Governor Koong's pirate station, then escape Screed as it smashes into an asteroid.
drd-1x11: Downed on Roon, Mungo and the droids join Auren Yomm's team at the Roon Games and, with C-3PO braving the Drainsweeper Race, beat Governor Koong's cheating squad.
drd-1x12: Mungo's dying great-uncle Oggem bequeaths him six bags of Roonstones, but after escaping Koong's slave galley, Mungo must sacrifice them to clear a whirlpool.
drd-1x13: Koong looses the Rooze plague on Umboo; Mungo, the Yomms, and the droids grab a cure from his volcano fortress as it freezes over, ending his reign.
lf-faithful-wookiee: A talisman's sleeping virus fells Han and Luke on Panna; Boba Fett helps Chewie fetch the cure, but R2-D2 intercepts his call to Darth Vader and exposes him.
lf-holiday: As Imperials ransack their Kashyyyk home, Chewbacca's family awaits him for Life Day; Lumpy tricks a stormtrooper, Chewie and Han arrive, and the Wookiees celebrate.
ewk-1x01: When a shared dream shows the Soul Trees in flames, Wicket and his friends, doubted by the elders, smother Morag's blaze from hang gliders with the Wisties' guidance.
ewk-1x02: Duloks steal the shadowroot soap meant to hide the sunberry trees from Morag's Mantigrue and haunt Bright Tree Village unseen, until the Ewoks recover it in time.
ewk-1x03: Morag and the Duloks hide a lost baby phlog so its parents attack the Ewoks, until Kneesaa and friends lull the Duloks asleep and bring the baby home.
ewk-1x04: When a strange fungus sickens their father Deej, Wicket and his brothers split up to gather ingredients for Logray's cure, finding an unexpected ally in the creature Mring-Mring.
ewk-1x05: Latara runs away with the Jinda troupe, but the Duloks net her as a babysitter for Queen Urgah's brats, and her friends pose as performers to rescue her.
ewk-1x06: Sent to rekindle the Tree of Light against the Night Spirit, Paploo, Teebo, and Wicket's brothers, with Wicket tagging along, stop the Duloks from toppling it.
ewk-1x07: The traveling Jindas spring Wicket and friends from Skandit captors, but a curse of flying rocks dogs the troupe until Kneesaa returns the Rock Wizard's missing tooth.
ewk-1x08: Wicket and friends help outcast Mring-Mring and his brother Oobel save the Gupin stronghold from Grass Trekkers; when the Juniper Chest opens at his touch, Mring-Mring becomes king.
ewk-1x09: Logray's new apprentice Teebo lands his friends in Morag's clutches; she seizes the Sunstar and becomes a lava monster, but Teebo helps Logray turn her to stone.
ewk-1x10: With Malani's help, Wicket restores his great-grandfather's battle wagon, but the Duloks steal it to raze the soul trees, and Wicket wrecks it to stop them.
ewk-1x11: Bored by her leadership lessons, Kneesaa learns them for real when a mutant stranglethorn overruns the village and she and Wicket must gather three ingredients to stop it.
ewk-1x12: A stolen love potion makes the phlog Hoona fall for Wicket, and the smitten giant, meant as the Duloks' weapon, helps drive them from the Ewoks' harvest feast.
ewk-1x13: Tales of a wild red-furred Ewok send Kneesaa into a blizzard after Asha, her long-lost sister raised by korrinas; together they foil the Duloks and bring Asha home.
ewk-2x01: Wicket, eager to fill his Belt of Honor, braves the Gracca's volcano for the stolen Crystal Cloak; the cloak is lost to lava, but he traps the Gracca.
ewk-2x02: Trusted to tend the Leaf Queen's wish plant, Kneesaa watches her friends' greed nearly kill it, until her remorseful tears revive it just as the Queen returns.
ewk-2x03: Fed up with chores, Wicket and Teebo move into a tree fort haunted by Shrieks, which prove to be one lonely runaway, Larry, whose story sends them home.
ewk-2x04: Latara plays princess for a day and is carried off by Gorphs seeking a royal bride for Prince Vork, until her friends crash the swamp wedding.
ewk-2x05: Wicket wakes the Raich, which entrances forest animals, even Baga, to devour them; the young Ewoks seek a magic cap from the two-headed Gonster to defeat it.
ewk-2x06: Wicket accepts a totem pole from a wandering stranger whose creatures loot the village and enslave Teebo, until Wicket turns the Totem Master's own spell on him.
ewk-2x07: Wicket's birthday gem for his mother Shodu, raided from the Lost Temple, is really a serpent egg, and it hatches after the Duloks steal it for Queen Urgah.
ewk-2x08: A comet brings the Stranger, a Night Spirit wizard who seizes the Sunstar to tear open a portal for his kind, until Wicket and friends reverse it.
ewk-2x09: Told he's too young to hunt the rampaging Hanadak, Wicket sets out alone, is captured by the Mimphs, and wins their gratitude by saving them from the beast.
ewk-2x10: The sorcerer Zarrak flatters struggling apprentice Teebo into joining him, then traps Logray and Wicket to extort the Sunstar, until Teebo's humble leaf magic brings Zarrak down.
ewk-2x11: Boys against girls, the young Ewoks peddle sick Mooth's wares for a prize of Eodon tusks; they flop yet win him customers, until the Eodon reclaims them.
ewk-2x12: Wicket bets Latara he can make a warrior of Teebo; when a Blog dams the Tambles' water, Teebo's magic, not his training, saves them, and Wicket loses.
ewk-2x13: Bewitched by Duchess Odra, the Snow King steals the Season Scepter and freezes Endor, until Wicket and friends storm his ice palace, free Kneesaa, and break the spell.
ewk-2x14: A canoe joyride loses the prow carving, which the Duloks fish out for their battleship; captured retrieving it, Wicket and friends sink the ship with the Skibs' help.
ewk-2x15: Kneesaa neglects her bordok Baga for Silky, a unicorn-like creature, until Silky carries her off to Jadru as Sunstar ransom, and Wicket and Baga come to the rescue.
ewk-2x16: Stuck babysitting, Wicket drags the woklings into Horville's Hut of Horrors; a botched dream-catcher dumps their nightmares on him, and the truth costs him the warriors' trip.
ewk-2x17: Latara lies to sea king Elbo for a jeweled flute and is hauled below, where she passes his test by prizing the wooden flute her friends made.
ewk-2x18: To encourage Malani, Wicket recounts how a bad-luck sprite made him flunk his warrior's test, and how he found his nerve again in the Cavern of Broken Dreams.
ewk-2x19: Framed once too often by houseguest Norky, Wicket and friends lure him to the Vacant Valley with a fake treasure map, then must save him from its sinkholes.
ewk-2x20: Rogue Imperial scientist Raygar steals the Sunstar to arm a cannon against the Emperor; Wicket and friends, helped by droid PD-28, fly into space to reclaim it.
ewk-2x21: Kneesaa's party for Prince Delby is crashed by the rowdy Pugs, who carry her off; once rescued, she finds the tardy prince shares her love of acorns.
ewk-2x22: Desperate to impress Wicket, Malani lets two thieves posing as fairies trick her into stealing the Sunstar, then helps him and his friends win it back.
lf-caravan: Stranded on Endor after a crash, Mace and Cindel Towani join Wicket's Ewoks on a perilous trek to free their parents from the giant Gorax.
lf-endor: Orphaned when Sanyassan marauders raid Bright Tree Village, Cindel escapes with Wicket, befriends hermit Noa and speedy Teek, and, after Wicket fells King Terak, leaves Endor with Noa.
